title: Anyone ever been to a gamestop?
content: I heard about this mallworld idea a while ago. I don't think it's a re-occurance for me, but I had a dream that was so unpleasant just now. The weirdest part of the dream was that I realized that it didn't go along like other dreams, and as I became uncomfortable with the dream itself, asking like, "Wtf is going on?" and what looked like a static image or paper cutout of a ghost appeared on the periphery of where I was, as if to trigger or scare me for having an existential crisis. So I had entered a gamestop at nighttime with a friend, and we were preparing to go do some activity like snowboarding. But the lights dimmed and the context disapeared. My friend forget he was going snowboarding, the NPCs in the dreams disapeared. I wandered around asking what is going on? There's supposed to be a 'plot' to this dream. Then I see outside across the street, across the parking lot the paper cutout of a ghost entity. Not moving, as if someone from 'behind the curtain' popped out and placed it down. It definitely was disturbing but not enough to distract me from my existential confusion as this dream. I'm losing the details now but it ended with me praying to God as I intuitively knew that I should invoke that power and get out. Not because I was in danger, but, I don't think any person could endure that anxiety that was building. I also had the intuition to ask "What time is it?" to someone there but I didn't want to freak myself out. Has anyone else been in a gamestop with dim lights and a parking lot outside?
